verdict.rationale: A third-party curated list exists: yibie/awesome-jev has 1,253 stars, 339 entries across 14 categories, including 57 infra/SDK/integration projects, plus an explicit curation policy. Community open-weight replicas are on Hugging Face (one with 471 likes), and a hands-on user reports calling Jev through the OpenRouter router, alongside documented AI-gateway examples. Missing for 10: evidence that third-party projects have active maintainers (commit recency, maintenance activity), and independent corroboration of the awesome-list figures beyond the list's own README.
